data.title: 泽塔 · 只留给一人的报告
data.description: 庭园谒见厅里，泽塔单膝跪在空着的王座前，握着刚封好的谍报卷轴。月光照在她抬起的脸上；等暗影大人回来，这份报告会先交到他手里。
data.location: shadow garden audience chamber with an empty dark throne and high moonlit windows
data.action: kneeling alone before an empty throne, holding a sealed intelligence report and looking up
data.lighting: 谒见厅高窗漏下的冷峻月光
data.promptProse: Zeta kneels alone before an empty throne, holding a sealed intelligence report as moonlight falls through the high windows.
data.animaCaption: Zeta holds the sealed report before the unoccupied throne.
